purpose: Hard product/sport boundary for the standalone Virtual Lab.
identity_rules: Stable participant identity is the primary recurrence key.
Club/team labels are contextual metadata and never identity keys.
A participant cannot cross product domains without explicit source evidence.
Unknown or truncated identities remain unresolved.
evidence_rules: User-supplied tickets remain external evidence and are excluded from automatic model training.
Automatically collected SportyBet result history is the training/evaluation source.
Historical observations are append-only research evidence.
